name: Voxel Splatting SART/SIRT
definition: An implementation of SART/SIRT proximal operators based on voxel splatting, where voxels are splatted into the detector to update ray-sum and weights images, using pre-integrated lookup tables for weights.
summary: Voxel Splatting SART/SIRT is a GPU-accelerated tomographic reconstruction method that inverts data flow by projecting voxels onto the detector plane, distinguishing it from ray-casting approaches.
